title: Rayuwar yau da kullum
description: Ten short, simple stories about everyday life in Hausaland: school, money, health, travel, news and more.

lessons.title: Aisha a makaranta
lessons.summary: Aisha eats, gets dressed and goes to school, and in the evening she tells her mother about her day.
lessons.text:
Yau Aisha za ta je makaranta. Aisha 'yar Kano ce, kuma tana son makarantarta.

Kafin ta je makaranta, Aisha ta sanya kayan makaranta. Kayan makarantarta suna da yawa. Sannan ta je wajen mahaifiyarta, Talatu.

"Ga abinci," Talatu ta ce. "Ci abinci kafin ki je makaranta."

Aisha ta ci abinci. Sannan ta sha ruwa. Bayan cin abinci, ta je makaranta.

A makaranta akwai yara da yawa. Yara suna karatu, kuma Aisha ma tana karatu. Duk yaran makarantar suna karatu tare.

Da rana, lokacin cin abinci ya yi. Yaran sun ci abinci, sun sha ruwa, sannan suka yi wasa. Bayan wasa, sai suka yi karatu kuma.

Bayan karatu, Aisha ta zo gida. Talatu ta ce, "Aisha, me aka yi a makaranta yau?"

"Yau na yi karatu da yawa," Aisha ta ce. "Na ci abinci, na sha ruwa, kuma na yi wasa da yara."

Tambayoyi:
Me Aisha ta sanya kafin ta je makaranta?
Aisha ta sanya kayan makaranta.
Me Aisha ta yi bayan ta sanya kayanta?
Ta ci abinci, sannan ta sha ruwa.
Me yara suka yi a makaranta?
Yara sun yi karatu, sun ci abinci, kuma sun yi wasa.
Bayan karatu, Aisha ta je ina?
Bayan karatu, Aisha ta zo gida.

lessons.title: Kuɗin Idris
lessons.summary: Idris needs money for school, so he finds work carrying water for Gambo and keeps what he earns.
lessons.text:
Idris ɗan makaranta ne a Katsina. Yana buƙatar kuɗi domin makaranta. Amma babu kuɗi a gidansu. Idris ba shi da kuɗi, kuma mahaifinsa ma ba shi da kuɗi.

Wata rana, Idris ya je wajen Gambo. Gambo yana da babban wurin aiki, kuma mutane da yawa suna aiki a wurin.

"Ina neman aiki," Idris ya ce masa. "Ina buƙatar kuɗi, kuma babu aiki a wani wuri."

Gambo ya ce, "Ka zo neman aiki a nan? Akwai aiki a nan. Mutanen nan suna buƙatar ruwa. Ka kawo musu ruwa."

Sai Idris ya kawo ruwa. Ya kawo ruwa duk rana. Bayan aiki, Gambo ya ba shi kuɗi.

Idris ya yi aiki har kwana goma. Sai Gambo ya ƙara masa kuɗi. "Na ƙara maka kuɗi saboda kana aiki da yawa," Gambo ya faɗa masa.

Yanzu Idris ya sami kuɗi da yawa. Ya sami kuɗin daga aikinsa. Amma bai kashe kuɗin ba.

"Ban kashe kuɗina ba," Idris ya faɗa wa Gambo. "Zan kai su makaranta."

Tambayoyi:
Me Idris yake buƙata?
Idris yana buƙatar kuɗi domin makaranta.
Idris ya je wajen wa?
Idris ya je wajen Gambo.
Me Idris ya kawo wa mutanen?
Idris ya kawo musu ruwa.
Idris ya kashe kuɗinsa?
Bai kashe su ba. Ya ce, "Ban kashe kuɗina ba."

lessons.title: Hannun Habiba
lessons.summary: Habiba's hand hurts, her mother calls the doctor, and after two days she feels well again.
lessons.text:
Yau Habiba ba ta jin daɗi. Hannunta yana ciwo sosai. Ba ta iya aiki da hannunta.

Larai, mahaifiyar Habiba, ta ji abin da Habiba ta ce. Sai Larai ta kira likita.

Likitan ya zo gidan. Ya ga hannun Habiba a hankali. "Rashin lafiya ne, amma ba babba ba ne," ya ce. "Wannan rashin lafiya ba babba ba ne."

"Hannunta zai samu lafiya?" Larai ta ce.

"Zai samu lafiya. Na tabbata," likitan ya ce. "Amma sai ta yi aiki da hannunta a hankali."

Habiba ta ji abin da ya ce. Duk rana tana aiki a hankali. Tana aiki da hannu ɗaya.

Bayan kwana biyu, Habiba ta ji daɗi sosai. Hannunta ya samu lafiya. Ta kira shi.

"Yanzu ina jin daɗi," Habiba ta ce masa. "Hannuna yana da lafiya."

"Na ji daɗin jin haka," likitan ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Habiba ba ta jin daɗi?
Hannunta yana ciwo sosai.
Larai ta kira wa?
Larai ta kira likita.
Likitan ya tabbata da me?
Ya tabbata cewa hannun Habiba zai samu lafiya.
Yanzu Habiba tana jin daɗi?
Haka ne, yanzu Habiba tana jin daɗi sosai.

lessons.title: Jirgin ƙasa zuwa Kano
lessons.summary: Umar takes the train from Zaria to the city of Kano, and the trip passes through three towns.
lessons.text:
Umar yana zama a Zaria. Yau zai je birnin Kano, inda yake aiki. Zai je ta jirgin ƙasa.

Tun da wuri, Umar ya je wurin jirgin. Tun yana yaro, yana son jirgin ƙasa. Mutane da yawa suna wurin. Kowa yana son ya je Kano.

Jirgin ya zo. Sai Umar ya shiga jirgin. Mutanen wurin ma sun shiga. Kowa ya samu wuri a cikin jirgin.

Tsakanin Zaria da Kano akwai garuruwa da yawa. Jirgin ya je ta gari uku. A kowane gari, wasu mutane sun shiga jirgin.

Umar ya ga garuruwa uku tsakanin Zaria da Kano. Daga cikin jirgin, ya ga gidaje da hanyoyi.

A ƙarshe, jirgin ya zo Kano. Kowa ya fita daga jirgin. Birnin Kano babba ne, kuma akwai mutane da yawa a birnin.

"Wannan ne ƙarshen tafiyata," Umar ya ce. Sai ya je inda yake aiki.

Tambayoyi:
Umar zai je ina?
Umar zai je birnin Kano.
Umar ya je ta me?
Umar ya je ta jirgin ƙasa.
Jirgin ya je ta gari nawa?
Jirgin ya je ta gari uku.
Me akwai tsakanin Zaria da Kano?
Tsakanin Zaria da Kano akwai garuruwa da yawa.

lessons.title: Jaridar Nasiru
lessons.summary: Nasiru reads in the newspaper about the state election and talks it over with his wife Jamila.
lessons.text:
Duk rana Nasiru yana karatun jarida. Yau ma yana karatun jaridar.

A jaridar yau akwai labari game da zaɓe. Za a yi zaɓe a jihar Kano. Gwamnatin jihar ta bayyana ranar zaɓen.

Nasiru yana son siyasa sosai. Amma matarsa Jamila ba ta son siyasa.

"Jamila, ga labari game da zaɓe," Nasiru ya ce. "Gwamnati ta bayyana ranar zaɓen jiha."

"Ba na son magana game da siyasa," Jamila ta ce.

"Amma zaɓe aikin jama'a ne," Nasiru ya ce. "Jaridar ta bayyana cewa al'ummar jihar suna buƙatar ruwa da hanyoyi. Jama'a za su yi zaɓe domin su samu ruwa da hanyoyi."

Jamila ta ji abin da Nasiru ya ce. Sai ta ce, "Haka ne. Al'ummarmu tana buƙatar ruwa. Ni ma zan yi zaɓe."

Nasiru da Jamila sun yi magana game da zaɓen har lokacin cin abinci.

Tambayoyi:
Me Nasiru yake yi duk rana?
Nasiru yana karatun jarida duk rana.
A jaridar yau akwai labari game da me?
Akwai labari game da zaɓe.
Me gwamnatin jihar ta bayyana?
Gwamnatin jihar ta bayyana ranar zaɓen.
Al'ummar jihar suna buƙatar me?
Al'ummar jihar suna buƙatar ruwa da hanyoyi.

lessons.title: Sabon gida
lessons.summary: Abdullahi and Hajara look at three houses in Kaduna and choose the one that is different from the others.
lessons.text:
Abdullahi da matarsa Hajara suna neman sabon gida a Kaduna. Wani mutum ya nuna musu gidaje uku. Waɗannan gidaje uku suna yanki ɗaya. Abdullahi ya ce, "Mu ga waɗannan gidaje."

Gida na farko ƙarami ne. "Wannan gida ƙarami ne," Hajara ta ce. "Ba zai yi mana amfani ba."

Gida na biyu babba ne, amma ba shi da kyau. "Wannan ya fi na farko girma, amma ba shi da kyau," Abdullahi ya ce.

Sai mutumin ya nuna musu gida na uku. Gida na uku daban ne. Yana da kyau sosai. Yana da ruwa, kuma yana da wurin wasa ga yara.

"Wannan ya fi su kyau," Hajara ta ce. "Cikin gidaje uku ɗin, shi ne mafi kyau." "Shi ɗin ne gidanmu," Abdullahi ya ce.

"Yankin ma yana da kyau," Abdullahi ya ce. "A wannan yanki akwai makaranta da hanya mai kyau."

Sai Abdullahi da Hajara suka sami sabon gida. Gidansu daban ne, kuma suna amfani da shi sosai.

Tambayoyi:
Mutumin ya nuna musu gidaje nawa?
Ya nuna musu gidaje uku.
Gida na farko yaya yake?
Gida na farko ƙarami ne.
Wane gida ne mafi kyau?
Gida na uku ne mafi kyau.
Me akwai a wannan yanki?
A wannan yanki akwai makaranta da hanya mai kyau.

lessons.title: Ƙungiyar Hamza
lessons.summary: Hamza's team in Gombe follows its leader's plan, plays together and wins.
lessons.text:
Hamza yana cikin wata ƙungiyar wasan ƙwallo a Gombe. Ƙungiyar tana da yara goma. Haruna shi ne shugaban ƙungiyar.

Yau ƙungiyar Hamza za ta yi wasa da wata ƙungiya daga Bauchi. Yaran suna son nasara sosai.

Kafin wasan, Haruna ya ce, "Muna da tsari. Dole ne mu yi wasa tare. Ya kamata kowa ya yi aikinsa. Kuma ya kamata mu yi wasa a hankali."

"Ina so mu sami nasara," Hamza ya ce.

"Ni ma ina so," Haruna ya ce. "Amma dole ne mu bi tsarinmu."

Sai aka fara wasan. Yaran suna wasa yadda Haruna yake so. Suna yin abin da suke iya yi, kuma suna yin abin da suke so. Kowa yana aikinsa, kamar yadda tsarin ya ce.

A ƙarshe, ƙungiyar Hamza ta yi nasara. "Mun yi nasara!" Hamza ya ce. "Mun yi wasa tare, kuma muna son ƙungiyarmu."

Tambayoyi:
Wa ne shugaban ƙungiyar?
Haruna ne shugaban ƙungiyar.
Ƙungiyar Hamza ta yi wasa da wace ƙungiya?
Ta yi wasa da wata ƙungiya daga Bauchi.
Me Haruna ya ce kafin wasan?
Ya ce, "Muna da tsari. Dole ne mu yi wasa tare."
Wace ƙungiya ta yi nasara?
Ƙungiyar Hamza ce ta yi nasara.

lessons.title: Rana a Sokoto
lessons.summary: Salisu works in the hot sun in Sokoto, feels his skin burn and decides to work indoors at midday.
lessons.text:
Salisu yana aiki a wajen gari a Sokoto. Yanayin Sokoto yana da zafi, musamman da rana. A wannan yanayi, akan sha ruwa da yawa.

Yau yanayin ya kasance mai zafi sosai. Rana ta kasance da zafi tun da wuri. Amma Salisu ya yi aiki a rana har lokacin cin abinci.

Da rana, Salisu ya taɓa fatarsa. Fatarsa tana da zafi. Sannan ya taɓa fatar hannunsa. Ita ma tana da zafi.

Sai Salisu ya yi tunani. "Wannan yanayi ba shi da kyau ga fata," ya ce. "Akan yi aiki a ciki da rana."

Ya shiga ciki. A ciki babu zafi sosai. Ya sha ruwa da yawa.

Salisu ya yi tunani game da duniya. "A duniya akwai wurare da yawa masu zafi kamar Sokoto," ya ce. "Musamman a irin waɗannan wurare, dole ne mutum ya yi tunani game da fatarsa."

Daga ranar, Salisu yana aiki a ciki da rana, musamman lokacin da yanayi yake da zafi.

Tambayoyi:
Yanayin Sokoto yana da zafi?
Yanayin Sokoto yana da zafi, musamman da rana.
Me Salisu ya ji da ya taɓa fatarsa?
Fatarsa tana da zafi.
Salisu ya shiga ina?
Salisu ya shiga ciki.
Me akan yi a lokacin zafi?
Akan sha ruwa da yawa.

lessons.title: Gaskiyar Tijjani
lessons.summary: Tijjani left his book at school, and when his father Sule asks about his reading he tells the truth.
lessons.text:
Sule yana da 'ya'ya biyu. Ɗansa na farko Tijjani ne. Tijjani yana zuwa makaranta duk rana.

Wata rana, Tijjani ya bar littafinsa a makaranta. Saboda haka bai yi karatu a gida ba.

Da dare, Sule ya ce wa ɗansa, "Shin, ka yi karatunka?"

Tijjani ya san cewa gaskiya tana da kyau.

"Ban yi ba," Tijjani ya ce. "Na bar littafina a makaranta. Wannan ce gaskiya."

"To," Sule ya ce. "Ka faɗa mini gaskiya. Gaskiya hali ne mai kyau. Ina son wannan halinka."

"Shin, wannan babbar matsala ce?" Tijjani ya ce.

"To, ka ji," Sule ya ce. "Ba babbar matsala ba ce. Na sani. Ka sani ma, wani lokaci mutum yana barin abu a wani wuri. Gobe za ka yi karatunka."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Tijjani ya bar littafinsa?
Tijjani ya bar littafinsa a makaranta.
Me Sule ya ce wa ɗansa?
Sule ya ce, "Shin, ka yi karatunka?"
Tijjani ya faɗa wa Sule gaskiya?
Haka ne, Tijjani ya faɗa masa gaskiya.
Sule yana son wane hali na Tijjani?
Sule yana son halinsa na gaskiya.

lessons.title: Ilimin Jummai
lessons.summary: Jummai never had the chance to go to school as a girl, so now she studies at night with the other women of the town.
lessons.text:
Jummai mace ce ta Sokoto. Lokacin da take ƙarama, ba ta samu damar zuwa makaranta ba. Duk rayuwarta, ba ta iya karatu ba.

Yanzu a garinsu akwai makaranta ta dare. A makarantar ana karatu da dare. Ana koya wa mata karatu.

"Wannan dama ce gare ni," Jummai ta ce. "Ilimi yana da amfani a rayuwa."

Jummai ta je makarantar. Sauran matan garin ma sun zo. Makarantar ta haɗa mata da yawa a wuri guda.

A makarantar, ana karatu tare. Jummai ta yi karatun littafi guda. Sannan ta yi na biyu. Sauran matan ma sun yi karatu.

'Yar Jummai, Fatima, ta ce, "Ilimi ba na yara kawai ba ne. Kowa yana iya samun ilimi."

"Haka ne," Jummai ta ce. "Na samu dama a ƙarshen rayuwata. Ilimi ya haɗa ni da sauran mata, kuma rayuwata ta yi daɗi."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Jummai ba ta iya karatu ba?
Lokacin da take ƙarama, ba ta samu damar zuwa makaranta ba.
Yaushe ake karatu a makarantar?
Ana karatu da dare.
Su wa suka zo makarantar tare da Jummai?
Sauran matan garin ma sun zo.
Me Fatima ta ce game da ilimi?
Ta ce, "Ilimi ba na yara kawai ba ne."
